mapper.insert: INSERT INTO forge_storage_object (id, object_key, filename, content_type, size, status, upload_expires_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{objectKey}, #{filename}, #{contentType}, #{size}, 'PENDING', #{uploadExpiresAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, object_key, filename, content_type, size, status, upload_expires_at, stored_at FROM forge_storage_object WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT quota_bytes FROM forge_storage_quota FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE forge_storage_object SET status = 'STORED', stored_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO forge_storage_quota (tenant_id, quota_bytes, plan_version) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{quotaBytes}, #{version}) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id) DO UPDATE SET quota_bytes = EXCLUDED.quota_bytes, plan_version = EXCLUDED.plan_version WHERE forge_storage_quota.plan_version < EXCLUDED.plan_version
